//: The Node files that also write browser code: the callbacks these hand to page.evaluate() run inside the page, so they need DOM globals, while the files around them need node:fs. Neither of the other two configs can express that, and widening the main lib to cover it would let `document` typecheck across the whole build and harness, which is what ADR-0013 exists to prevent. Everything here is excluded from tsconfig.json rather than checked twice, so a file joining this list has to be added in both places or it keeps the DOM-free checking it was moved here to escape.
